scenes.say: More choice sounds like freedom. It's actually how stores lose sales.
Choice overload: with too many options, we're so scared of choosing wrong we don't choose.
Iyengar and Lepper set up a jam stand. Sometimes 6 flavours. Sometimes 24.
With 6: {few} of visitors bought. With 24: just {many}.
Every extra option adds thinking cost, and the fear of picking wrong.
Stuck between too many options? Cut to three, then compare.

takeaway: Stuck between too many options? Cut to three, then compare.
